descriptions.admin: Secure your installation with its first administrator.
descriptions.workspace: Give your team a place to work together.
descriptions.email: Connect email now, or leave it for later.
descriptions.review: Check everything before creating your workspace.

heroDescription: A few focused steps to make Bubllio yours. Nothing is created until you confirm the final review.
privacy: Private setup · Your data stays in your installation
tokenNotice: Copy the one-time token from the server's BUBLLIO_SETUP_TOKEN setting. It stays in memory only while this page is open.
setupTokenHelp: The one-time token configured on your server; not your admin password.
adminUsernameHelp: Use this to sign in to Bubllio and Django admin.
adminEmailHelp: Email address for the first administrator account.
adminPasswordHelp: Choose a strong password of at least 8 characters.
workspaceNameHelp: The name your team will see in the app, for example Nerds Lab.
workspaceSlugHelp: A short lowercase identifier, for example nerds-lab.
ownerNotice: The admin account from the previous step becomes this workspace's owner.
smtpOptional: This step is optional. You can add an email account later from account or workspace settings.
encryptionNotice: Set BUBLLIO_EMAIL_ENCRYPTION_KEYS on the server before finishing setup. The test below sends a real email.
accountLabelHelp: A name for this SMTP account, for example Primary.
senderEmailHelp: The address recipients will see as the sender.
smtpHostHelp: Provided by your email service, for example smtp.example.com.
smtpUsernameHelp: The username supplied by your email provider.
smtpPasswordHelp: Often an app password, not your personal email password.
ssl: Use SSL on port 465 (unchecked: STARTTLS on port 587)
testDescription: We'll send one message using the SMTP details above. Nothing is saved until you finish setup.
testRecipientHelp: Use an inbox you can check now to confirm delivery.
testFailed: Could not send the test email. Check the SMTP settings and recipient, then try again.
testAccepted: The SMTP server accepted a test email. Check the recipient inbox to confirm delivery.
testMissing: No successful test email yet. You can go back to test it or finish setup and troubleshoot later.
completionNotice: Completing setup creates the admin account and workspace. You will sign in afterward.
